parallel.description: True only when the request splits into parts that are truly independent: disjoint files, no ordering, each testable alone.

reason.description: One or two sentences: why the parts are independent, or why the request stays one item.

parts.description: The independent parts when parallel is true; empty otherwise.

title.description: A short imperative title, at most 60 characters.

request.description: A self-contained request for the developer who builds only this part: what to change, where, and how to check it.

paths.description: Repository-relative files, directories or globs this part touches. Parts must not share any path.
